download.subtitle: Web, Android, and desktop clients (macOS / Windows / Linux) share the same identity and session. iOS is coming soon.

download.mobileBody: iOS and Android support, powered by minibot-react-native as the companion app.
download.iosFooter: The iOS client is in preparation and will be available from the App Store.
download.androidFooter: Scan the QR code below or click download to install the Android client.
download.desktopBody: Mac, Windows, and Linux apps run a local minibot gateway on :8766 and sign in through auth.liuyidi.me.
download.desktopFooter: Install the desktop app to run minibot locally on this computer.
download.macosBody: Built for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
download.macosFooter: Open the DMG and drag minibot V2 into Applications. If macOS says it is damaged, run xattr -cr '/Applications/minibot V2.app'.
download.windowsFooter: Run the setup executable. SmartScreen may warn until the build is code-signed.
download.footer: Desktop and Android packages are published via the release manifest. iOS will appear here when ready.
download.linuxFooter: Install the downloaded package with your distro's package manager.
